I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. I confirmed the 2026 Marrow Agrisupply renewal is 84 seats, and that I made no other changes, since he said no action was needed. I also suggested he correct his earlier post in #central-team, because people there would still see the wrong number. I didn't open #central-team to check that post. I'm going on his word that the number there is wrong.

Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, and he had already posted the number in that channel, so repeating it there was fine. I didn't send any mail or approval requests.
